name: Neon Glass 3D
description: Dark futuristic 3D: frosted glass objects with glowing neon edges over a reflective black floor, bloom and light sparks, a camera that punches in on every cut and sweeps around the subject. High-energy AI / crypto / cyber aesthetic. Karaoke captions. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Write 6-10 punchy scenes (3-5 s each). Every scene has title.kicker + title.main and visual.type "scene3d" with 1-4 objects: one glowing hero (chip, lock, server, globe, phone, coin, rocket, lightbulb, icon) or a small system with connect arrows. Mark the key object with highlight: true. Short labels. Strong numbers go in a stat object. Never use emoji.
